snippet.title: 5 కోట్ల లారీల మట్టి ఒక్క డ్యామ్‌లో! ఇంత మట్టి ఎక్కడిది? 😱 Nizam Sagar Dam in Telugu
snippet.description:
5 కోట్ల లారీల మట్టి ఒక్క డ్యామ్‌లో! ఇంత మట్టి ఎక్కడిది? 😱 Nizam Sagar Dam Story in Telugu
సగానికి పైగా నీళ్ల నిల్వ మాయం! 🤯 Nizam Sagar Silt Problem Explained in 3D

Telangana lo Nizam paalanalo nirminchina Nizam Sagar, iravai Hussain Sagarlaku saripadaa neetini nilva cheyagaligina bhaari reservoir. Kaani konni dashabdaala tharvatha choosthe, neellu nilva undaalsina sthalamlo sagaaniki paiga maayam! Asalu okka laari kooda ikkadiki matti theesukochi poyaledhu – mari inni kotla laareela matti ekkadi nunchi vachindhi? Ee 3D animation lo choodandi: how the Manjeera river filled Nizam Sagar dam with mud, explained in Telugu.

Prathi varshaakaalamlo Manjeera nadhi polallo ni mattini kottukochi dam lo kaluputhundhi. Dam loki vacchaaka neeti vegam thaggi, aa mattanthaa nemmadigaa aduguki cheri – yedaadhi tharvaatha yedaadhi, porala meedha poralugaa perukuntu vachindhi. Mattini theeyadam kashtam kaabatti engineers neellu nilva chese etthuni naaluguunnara adugulu penchaaru, varadha pramaadham kosam pakkane maro spillway kattaaru. Dhaanitho nilva saamardhyam pannendu TMC la nunchi paddenimidi TMC laku perigindhi – ee rojuki Nizamabad, Kamareddy lo dhaadhaapu rendu lakshala ekaraala pantlaku ee neelle praanaadhaaram.

Facts: built 1923–1931 under the Nizam of Hyderabad · masonry dam ≈ 3 km, 48 crest gates · original capacity 29.72 TMC, 11.8 TMC left in the 1973 survey (≈ 60 % lost to silt) · full reservoir level raised from 1,400.5 ft to 1,405 ft (4.5 ft) and an auxiliary spillway added · capacity at the new level 17.8 TMC · water spread 129.5 km² (Hussain Sagar ≈ 4.4 km², 0.83–0.96 TMC) · command area 2.31–2.75 lakh acres.
Note: "5 crore lorries" is a ruler: 17.9 TMC lost ≈ 507 million m³ ÷ about 10 m³ per small tipper load ≈ 5 crore loads (approximate). "20 Hussain Sagars" is conservative on both area and volume. The dam, the silt and the remodelling are shown in simplified 3D.
Sources:

• 60.47 % storage lost to silt, auxiliary spillway – Deccan Chronicle: https://www.deccanchronicle.com/southern-states/telangana/nizamsagar-lost-6047-storage-capacity-due-to-silt-1850093
• 48 crest gates – Telangana Today: https://telanganatoday.com/nizam-sagar-records-second-highest-inflow-in-50-years
• 17.8 TMC at FRL 1,405 ft – Telangana Today: https://telanganatoday.com/11-gates-of-nizam-sagar-opened
• Hussain Sagar – Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hussain_Sagar

snippet.title: Elon's No-Commission Motivation Trick
snippet.description:
How do you get people to sell without paying commission?

Elon wanted Tesla stores to be the total opposite of car dealerships. So, no commissions.

Jon McNeill, former president of Tesla and former COO of Lyft, leaned on a lesson from Charlie Munger: if you want to know how a system works, follow the incentives.

His team put a leaderboard in every store, with a line drawn almost arbitrarily in the middle. No money, no commission. People did a lot to get above that line, which meant asking for the order.

Incentives don't always need to be monetary. But you do need to understand them.

snippet.title: Apple Is "Losing" the AI Race... Just Like Before It Killed BlackBerry #Apple #AppleAI #TechNews #ai
snippet.description:
Apple Is "Losing" the AI Race... Just Like Before It Killed BlackBerry

Everyone thinks Apple is behind in AI—delaying Siri and teaming up with Google. But Apple has never needed to be first to win.
Just like the iPhone wiped out BlackBerry by focusing on usability over being first to market, Apple is running the exact same playbook with AI. By putting neural engines in iPhones since 2017, owning the entire hardware-to-OS stack, and giving developers free on-device & private cloud AI with just 3 lines of Swift, Apple is making AI effortless to build and use.
Plus, with new AI integrations in Xcode and automated testing, building an iOS app has never been easier.
